'''Vornest Dep-thesel Digarsarg''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Balinaka]] [[Sculptor/Legends|sculptor]]. He was the first to incorporate fragments of [[Gemstone/Legends|gemstones]] and [[Color/Legends|colored]] [[pumice]] in his [[Water/Legends|ice]] sculptures, creating what he called the "[[Crystal of the Stars]]." This led to the creation of the famed [[Garnib crystal]]s, and indirectly [[Galactic Crystal Creations]] when he showed the sculpture to his [[Human/Legends|Human]] friend, [[Abram Zavict]].
